sloka: शूलं भग्नं हनुमता दृष्ट्वा वानरवाहिनी।हृष्टा ननाद बहुशः सर्वतश्चापि दुद्रुवे ।। ६.६७.६५ ।।
transliteration: śūlaṁ bhagnaṁ hanumatā dṛṣṭvā vānaravāhinī।hṛṣṭā nanāda bahuśaḥ sarvataścāpi dudruve ।। 6.67.65 ।।

translations.english: Then a rejoiced monkey, resting the thousand bharas iron pike on his knee broke it.
